# [Baseline] - WIN - U - Microsoft Edge Management

Allows the Edge Management Service on managed devices and lets the policy configured there take precedence over local and MDM policy, so that Intune and that service do not work against each other.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Microsoft Edge - U - Management |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_Microsoft_Edge_Management.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_Microsoft_Edge_Management.json) |

> New in OIB v4.0. Does not require anyone to use the Edge Management Service (admin.cloud.microsoft → Edge); as long as nothing is configured there, nothing changes. The version and extension monitoring in that service is free reporting and also works without any further policy. Management in that portal requires the Entra role Edge Administrator.
